SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Multi-tier typographic headline stack combining architectural kicker, high-impact serif headline, italic accent clause, and descriptive subdeck.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Publishing longforms
•
High-craft product launches
•
Thought leadership manifestos
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Dense tabular settings
•
Compact mobile tooltips
JOBS TO BE DONE
Establish immediate intellectual authority and typographic craft at the top of an article or product page
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
High-contrast typographic hierarchy, fluid font sizing, accessible DOM semantics
TARGET PRODUCT ARCHETYPES
b2b-saas (95%)
developer-tool (90%)
consumer-subscription (85%)
